name: Knock Out

description.content: Whenever a Survivor drops a Pallet, for the next [6s], if they move [10m] away from it, they gain [20%] [Hindered] for [4s].
This ends early if the Pallet is broken.

quote: "Oh, that gun's no good. The old way... with a sledge! You see, that way's better. They die better that way." -Nubbins Sawyer
